input.idea: I Built a Structure That Survives Block Decay, But Every Block I Place Causes Surrounding Blocks to Decay

reasoning: The idea provides a concrete challenge (blocking decay), a unique twist (block placement causing decay), and a reason to watch (surviving a collapsing structure). It avoids formulaic patterns and offers visually engaging decay mechanics. The premise creates curiosity about how the player will adapt.
improved_version: I Built a Structure That Survives Block Decay, But Every Block I Place Causes Surrounding Blocks to Decay... and I Only Have 24 Hours Before the World Collapses
improvement_reasoning: Adding a time limit increases urgency and stakes, creating stronger escalation. The 24-hour constraint forces the player to prioritize building decisions and adds a ticking clock element that enhances retention potential and visual tension.
